title: Specified insertion isomorphism of ordinary quotient towers
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y, and every arbitrary unbounded completed-coefficient complex P on Y, there is a tower isomorphism a:(tower P)⋙trfInverseImageComplex g ≅ integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor g P. Its component at n is exactly QuotientTensor.insertion g n applied to unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex n P. The constructions are those of [def-fix-qcqs-completion-ordinary-models, def-pur-integral-derived-operations, def-trf-isomorphism-strict-quotient-models, lem-trf-quotient-tensor-insertion].

source.place: Tags 03D2 and 03EL, specializing the adjunction and quotient insertion to expanded clause 4 of def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists.

proof.text: The two chosen strict quotient tower presentations are definitionally equal: at none the restricted site, projection and normalized scalar-extension constructions are exactly the unrestricted constructions. Apply the existing proved unrestricted insertion_iso before restriction to Good. Its component is exactly QuotientTensor.insertion by reflexivity. No tower transport is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem isomorphismOrdinaryQuotientTowerNormalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (P : Cx l E Y none) :
    ∃ a : (tower l E Y none).obj P ⋙ trfInverseImageComplex l E g ≅
      (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E g).obj P,
      ∀ n : ℕ, a.hom.app (op n) = QuotientTensor.insertion l E g n
        ((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P)
